overview_description.description:
Clay is a technology firm that develops solutions to incorporate into the field of e-Learning. 

Welcome to Clay (Trademark No. 2,958,788), company synonymous with Innovation and Quality (International Award of Excellence by the eLearning sector). They are the first Spanish company to obtain by AENOR ISO 20000 certification which guarantees the excellence of comprehensive eLearning that oftrecemos.

they are shaped by a multidisciplinary team of software engineers, educators, graphic designers, writers and experts in different areas offering Business and Pubic Administration development of technological applications, portals / custom virtual campus, training platforms, training content as conversion to online learning materials and consulting in eLearning format.
